## Documented role

The [Governor General Order of Canada citation](../sources/2023-order-of-canada-paul-gauthier.qmd) (awarded 11 May 2023) calls him “Initiator of British Columbia’s Choice in Supports for Independent Living” and co-founder of the Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society. That is an official honour citation, not a ministry design file, and it does not date CSIL.

## Attributed recollection

Later IFRC materials attributed to Gauthier, or describing him, disagree on the start year: [2014 slides](../sources/2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd) say CSIL was “established” in 1993 and mention a 50-person pilot; [2015 Module 1](../sources/2015-gauthier-csil-module-1.qmd) uses 1994 in an otherwise similar sentence; [IFRC Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) says he “started on the CSIL program in 1994.” Those are later attributions, not inspected 1990s records.
